title: Structured Clone vs Transferable Ownership
description: Trace how ArrayBuffer ownership moves across thread boundaries without copying bytes.

steps.label: 1. Main Thread Allocates Buffer
steps.description: The main thread allocates a 16 MB Uint8Array backed by an ArrayBuffer on its own V8 heap.

steps.label: 2. postMessage(buf, [buf]) Transfer
steps.description: The engine detaches the ArrayBuffer from the main thread and hands the pointer to the worker's MessagePort.

steps.label: 3. Worker Processes Off-Thread
steps.description: The worker runs heavy parsing on its own event loop while main-thread frames stay under 16.6ms.
